context: WebGL-accelerated animated treemap tech demo: 5,000 leaf nodes switching between Revenue and Headcount layouts at 60fps via instanced quad rendering
first_impression: Clean header and controls frame a dense, color-coded treemap that looks competent but is undermined by a silent color-collision bug across sector groups.
what_works: The Tol palette is a deliberate, colorblind-friendly choice over schemeCategory10, and the button/tooltip styling is clean and consistent with the overall neutral aesthetic. Typography has a clear hierarchy from title to subtitle to in-map labels.
what_doesnt: The 7-color Tol palette wraps for 10 sectors, causing Real Estate and Healthcare to share the same green, Finance and Utilities to share the same pink, and Technology and Telecom to share the same blue — the categorical color encoding is silently broken. Sector label text is rendered with no background fill against colored cells, making labels on mid-tone hues (green, pink) difficult to read.
